title: Two claims naming one worktree refuse test registration, and the offered remedy may be unavailable
outcome: A holder with two claims on one worktree knows beforehand that a run there won't register, or the run registers against the one claim that can be determined, with no credit granted on a guess.
acceptance: It's decided from source whether naming a second claim onto a worktree already named should warn or refuse at naming time rather than failing a later run, and the decision is implemented with a behaviour test, a review pair with no Medium or higher and the normal gate; no run ever credits an ambiguous claim.
